currentFocus.text: Admin panel core features are the immediate focus for v1.0 readiness: product management, order processing, and role-based controls.
Storefront execution should prioritize shared components first, then listing/cart/checkout flows to avoid duplicate UI work.
Integration hardening is the v1.2 critical path: ERP sync consistency, payment webhooks, and queue observability.

recommendations: Keep blocker reasons mandatory for all Blocked tasks to reduce context switching and improve handoffs.
Update Done Date on completion and review overdue items daily to keep health metrics trustworthy.
Use milestone status changes only during weekly planning so roadmap trends remain stable and meaningful.
Treat payment and sync regressions as P0 and keep dedicated test coverage visible in task priority views.

milestones.title: v1.0 — Admin Panel Launch
milestones.description: Full CRUD for products, categories, orders, users, and role-based access with production-ready auditability.

milestones.title: v1.1 — Vue Storefront Beta
milestones.description: Public storefront with product listing, cart, checkout, wishlist, and reusable component foundations.

milestones.title: v1.2 — Integrations Release
milestones.description: Luceed two-way sync, CorvusPay/KeksPay/WSPay live checkout flows, and hardened queue operations.

milestones.title: v1.3 — PWA & Mobile
milestones.description: PWA for mobile users, improved installability, and baseline offline browsing for core catalog flows.
